container_details.notes: Brand-wide Polymaker announcement (all filaments moved to 100% recycled cardboard spools); PolyFlex is a Polymaker line. A follow-up Polymaker post (https://polymaker.com/polymaker-switches-all-products-to-100-recycled-spools/) states 'The cardboard used to make the spool and box comes from 100% recycled sources.' No certification named.
container_details.source_quote: Moving forward, Polymaker will produce all filaments on a 100% recycled cardboard spools.
